name: Mel Glover
source:
Likes: Snow apples
Dislikes: Bothersome things
Hobby: Seeking magical plants in the world
Skill: Purification magic

"I'm not even a student, so why would I become buddies with you?"

Sigurd: Mel is the gifted Magical Tree Doctor.
The major textbooks about magical plants are written by him.
He speaks less, and always feels bother to explain something to people.
His personality is misread by many people but he is truly a gentle person.
His purification magic is very generous and beautiful.

[Official in-game description]
